entry.name: send
entry.description: send will transmit given messages to receive objects which are named by the same argument and will allow you to send any kind of message between Patcher windows or within a window without using patch cords. A send object can be instantiated simply by typing into an object box the short-form letter "s".

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name theobject.
